ngaap.notes: EBITDA build (as published in this release): NI attributable to Vulcan + income tax expense (continuing ops) + interest expense, net + LOSS ON DISCONTINUED OPERATIONS NET OF TAX + DDA&A. The discontinued-ops add-back sits in the EBITDA build, not in the EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA bridge, so adj_items.disc_ops = 0 and the schema check ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda = ebitda_pub is short by exactly ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_aftertax (2.1); it ties when that field is included. Business development = non-routine charges/gains associated with acquisitions and dispositions incl. purchase-accounting inventory step-up. Restructuring charges listed separately in this period's bridge. Adjusted EPS bridge starts at diluted EPS net earnings; eps_items_after_tax_ps includes the discontinued-operations per-share amount (shown as separate 'Less: Discontinued operations' line) so that start + items + discrete = adjusted. 'Acquisition financing interest costs' (0.00 where shown) counted in items. Discrete tax = Calica NOL carryforward valuation allowance. ROIC = TTM Adjusted EBITDA / 5-quarter average invested capital, in percent.
